author: webtkdev
text:
A prompt-injection filter is not a security boundary.

Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its filter (CVE, Nov 6).

If your CI agent reads issues or PRs:
- pin a fixed version
- read-only token
- no secrets on issue triggers
- humans start write jobs
